newsitem.title: GERMANY: DIW sees German '97, '98 GDP growth under 2 pct.
newsitem.headline: DIW sees German '97, '98 GDP growth under 2 pct.

text.p: Germany's DIW economic institute, one of the country's six leading economic think-tanks, said on Wednesday gross domestic product growth this year and next would be just under two percent.

In west Germany, the economy would grow two percent in 1997 and 1998, while expanding around 1.5 percent during the same period in east Germany. Jobless levels would hit 4.4 million in Germany this year and more than 4.6 million next year, it said.
